rules.rule: buyerSellerIndicator field in Kafka output: BUYER->B, SELLER->S (case-insensitive input), missing tag->field omitted, blank tag->defaults to B, invalid value->empty string
amount field in Kafka output must always show exactly 2 decimal places - truncated without rounding for >2 decimals, padded with zeros for <2 decimals, .00 appended for integers

buyerSellerIndicator field in Kafka output: BUYER->B, SELLER->S (case-insensitive input), missing tag->field omitted (with warning), blank tag->defaults to B (with warning), invalid value->empty string (with warning). Processing must not fail due to missing/blank/invalid value.

The amount field in Kafka output must always show exactly 2 decimal places for successfully enriched/published trades: truncated (not rounded) when input has more than 2 decimals, padded with trailing zeros when input has fewer than 2 decimals, and '.00' appended when input has no decimal places. This rule applies only to trades that are actually PUBLISHED to trade-log-topic; rejected/failed trades routed to DLT are not subject to this output formatting since no enriched amount is published.
